game: HOU@SEA Week 7 2025, kickoff 2025-10-20 22:00 ET, SEA -3, total 41.5, outdoors, weather not saved

script.base: SEA is a 3-point home favorite in a 41.5 outdoor game (implied SEA 22.2 / HOU 19.2), so the base path is competitive into the fourth quarter with Seattle up one score late, not a blowout. Seattle closes on Kenneth Walker (39 carries, 201 yards, 5.15 YPC in weeks 4-6) beside Zach Charbonnet (33/99), while throws concentrate on Jaxon Smith-Njigba (27 targets, 373 yards, 360 air) with AJ Barner (13/156/91) as the middle option. Houston, with Christian Kirk out, still has to throw to stay in range via Nico Collins (22/235/274 air in weeks 3-5) and Dalton Schultz (18/129/130), but Seattle's run defense (3.41 YPC, only 5 runs of 10+ in 6 games) should cap Nick Chubb (33/146) and Woody Marks (30/120).
script.flip1: Seattle leads by two scores early and clocks it with Walker and Charbonnet. Houston abandons the run, so Chubb's rushing under cashes, but pass volume dies and Barner's receiving over is the leg at risk if Darnold's attempts shrink.
script.flip2: Houston hangs around or leads, Stroud airs it out (SEA blitzes only 19%, and Houston's EPA/db is +0.22 when not blitzed vs -0.16 when blitzed), Walker carries stall, and if Devon Witherspoon (questionable, knee) sits Collins becomes the ceiling. Unsaved wind or rain would drag the 41.5 total toward unders and more rushes.

injury_fallout: Christian Kirk is Out (hamstring) after 16 targets, 109 yards and 161 air yards in Houston's weeks 3-5 log, so that share should move first to Collins (already 22 targets) and Schultz (18), with Xavier Hutchinson (9/51/39; last4 rec yards 29, 16, 17, 18) and Jayden Higgins (6/61/54, no prop listed) as secondary absorbers. No saved prices to confirm those lines moved. SEA LB Derick Hall is Out (oblique), a small plus for Houston rush fits and for Schultz/Marks catches, and a direct caveat against a Chubb rushing under. SEA T Josh Jones is Questionable (ankle): if he sits, Seattle run efficiency and pass protection dip. SEA CB Devon Witherspoon (knee) and S Julian Love (hamstring) are Questionable, not out; if either is inactive Houston's receivers improve, but that is not confirmed. HOU CB Alijah Huzzie is Out (knee) and S Jaylen Reed is Questionable (knee), thinning a secondary that already allows 8.51 YPA on middle throws. HOU DE Denico Autry is Questionable (knee); if he sits, Houston's pass rush dips, a mild plus for Darnold and Barner. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Chubb under lost because Hall's absence and a 20-17 outdoor grind let Houston hand Chubb 16-18 carries, the 3.41 YPC figure did not travel, and one 20-yard run turned a 40-yard day into the same 61-yard spike already in the last four. Barner over lost because Seattle led by 10 at half, Walker and Charbonnet closed the game, Darnold threw about 22 times, JSN took double-digit targets, and Barner finished on two catches under 23 yards, with the 53 and 71 having been single explosives the pack cannot disprove. The shared killer is an early Seattle lead that helps the Chubb under and kills the Barner over, which is why these are a one-story lean slip, not a max-confidence pair. A Houston lead flips it the other way: Chubb's carry count rises and the under dies while Barner can still hit.
slip_story: One low-total, one-score story: Seattle's run defense and the 19.2 Houston implied total suppress Chubb under 47.5, and Seattle still throws enough, into a Houston middle that allows 8.51 YPA, for Barner to clear a median-lagging 29.5. Not a shootout stack. Do not pair with a game over, with JSN over 113.5, or with Walker rush over 59.5, which needs the late-lead carry script that starves Barner. Collins was left off this slip on purpose.
